firmware: tools/install-dsp-firmware copies this tablet's own signed adsp.mdt/.bNN, mba.mbn and modem.mdt/.bNN from the read-only mounted modem partition to /usr/lib/firmware/qcom/msm8996/samsung/gts3llte; hashes kept privately (private/audio/dsp-firmware-sha256.txt); no vendor binaries in Git.
memory_layout: Signed images exceed mainline MSM8996 carve-outs: modem.mdt spans 0x6c00000 at 0x88800000 (stock), relocatable adsp.mdt 0x2100000. GPU variant: mpss 0x88800000+0x6c00000, adsp 0x8f400000+0x2100000, gpu zap 0x91500000+1M, venus 0x91600000+5M, mba 0x91b00000+2M, rest of stock peripheral region 0x91d00000+8M; SLPI region dropped. No overlaps; GPU zap still loads, 0 GPU faults.

audio.status: Headphones and analog mics work through the ADSP; built-in speakers not supported yet.
audio.chain: ADSP (PAS 1, SMD APR) -> SLIMbus NGD -> WCD9335 v2.0 (reset TLMM 74, IRQ TLMM 79, MCLK PM8994 GPIO15 div_clk1, S4 supplies)
fixes: QCOM_SNS_REG disabled: the ADSP requested qcom/sensors/sns.reg; the 60 s firmware fallback stalled udev and delayed the sound card to ~130 s.
Each MIC BIAS routed to MCLK as in stock: capture returned only zeros because the decimators were unclocked.
Patch 0035: back end fixed at S16_LE; the ADSP rejects AFE_PORT_CMD_DEVICE_START for 24-bit SLIMbus ports.
Patch 0036: backport of mainline q6asm-dai stream-close fixes (cee3e63e7106, 048c540ee76d, 4b4db09f283d).
Patch 0037: capture stop pauses and flushes like downstream instead of EOS (EOS left CMD_CLOSE failing in a loop).
WirePlumber rule: microphones opened as S16LE (24-bit ASM capture open fails) and period-interrupt scheduling.
UCM profile Samsung/gts3llte HiFi: Headphones (digital ceiling -12 dB), Internal Microphone (AMIC3), Headset Microphone (AMIC2).

validation.playback: Silent streams only (no listener): DAPM showed SLIMBUS_6_RX, SLIM RX5/6, RX INT1/2 and HPHL/HPHR PA powered with MCLK enabled; PipeWire Headphones sink played 3 of 3 sessions after idle with 0 DSP errors.
validation.capture: Main mic -64.9 dBFS and sub mic -66.2 dBFS room noise via ALSA; headset input -76.7 dBFS with nothing plugged in. PipeWire: first recording works; repeated recordings remain unreliable (DSP CMD_CLOSE timeout after pause/flush).
validation.physical_listening: Pending owner check with wired headphones.

limits: Speakers: four Richtek RT5508 boosted amplifiers on BLSP1 I2C3 and primary TDM have no mainline driver; porting needs care to avoid speaker damage.
No headphone jack detection (mainline wcd9335 has no MBHC): Headphones and headset mic are always offered.
Repeated PipeWire capture sessions are unreliable.

modem.status: Modem boots on mainline, serves QMI over QRTR; SIM test pending.
modem.safety: Before the first boot fsg and fsc were backed up (they had no backup), with modemst1/2, device and host SHA-256 matched (private/backups/<UTC>-modem-fs). modemst2 differed from the 2026-10-10 backup (an Android boot after it); both kept. rmtfs runs with -r (writes stay in RAM, files opened O_RDONLY, sync is a no-op) and the four partitions are set read-only at the block layer (tabs3-base rmtfs drop-in).
modem.validation: MBA authenticated and loaded mpss; remoteproc running; 36 QRTR services announced on the modem node (DMS, NAS, WMS, Voice, UIM, WDS, ...); firmware MPSS.TH.2.0.1.c1-00136 (2019-11-20); operating mode online; IMEI readable (not recorded); SIM absent; without a SIM the radio found a GSM network with limited (emergency) service at about -55 dBm; starts at boot.
limits: Mobile data: MSM8996 uses IPA v2.5, which mainline does not support; ModemManager and oFono will not create a modem without an IPA network device, so no data, SMS or calls through the desktop yet.
Modem EFS changes are discarded at every reboot (read-only rmtfs) by design.
tqftpserv is installed but disabled; carrier MCFG files (modem_pr) are not served.

buttons: Kernel package 34+ (patch 0034, gpio-keys, PON RESIN, TC305K): devices probe, firmware 0x18 answers, no idle interrupts; physical presses pending.
known_issues: Intermittent pclk0/pclk1 'rcg didn't update its configuration' warnings while the panel driver loads (pre-existing).
